content:
>be me  
>14, confused, just trying to exist  
>just want to hold a boy’s hand. simple human contact. like, walking down the hallway, fingers intertwined, being cute together  
>but no. society explodes  
>tfw even if it wasn’t *the* boy, I just want to hold *any* boy’s hand without people losing their goddamn minds  
>lined up against the wall of public rejection and full-on persecution for *existing*  
>mfw people act like queer love is a personal attack on their cereal consumption  
>why do they care? why do they *hate*? we’re not burning churches, we’re just holding hands and being soft  
>literally ironic. they claim “love is love” until it’s two dudes existing in proximity  
>hearing homophobes talk like we don’t sit next to them in class, eat lunch in the same cafeteria, cry in the same bathroom stalls  
>any chance of “normal” social life? deleted. permanently. just like my Instagram after I posted that anime boy blush meme with “he’s kinda cute 😳”  
>now i can’t even pretend to be “one of the guys”  
>I like lace, soft colors, being a cute girly boy?? what part of that threatens your existence  
>tfw you’re just a twink with feelings in a world that wants you to be a machine  
>”stay in the closet” but the closet has no food, no windows, and Stephen from gym class guarding the door with a baseball bat  
>just wanted love. got homophobia, internalized shame, and a Discord full of edgelords instead  
>mfw I realize holding hands might be the most radical act of my teenage life  
>be like  
>I just want to hold this boy’s hand... is that a crime?  
>yes. yes it is. according to the school handbook, the church, and Trevor who won’t stop doing Nazi salutes in history class  
>autistic screeching intensifies  

\>>be gay  
\>>be cute  
\>>get erased
